name: ASSETUKR
description: ASSETUKR is a Ukrainian translation of ASSET (Alva-Manchego et al., 2020), a benchmark for sentence simplification with multiple rewriting transformations. It is intended for validating and fine-tuning Ukrainian text simplification models. The dataset keeps the structure of ASSET: 2,000 validation and 359 test original sentences, each with 10 simplified variants. The text was translated with Helsinki-NLP/opus-mt-en-uk, and the entire dataset was manually checked by two native Ukrainian speakers. Alignment with the English ASSET is preserved. Limitations: the data is translated from English, so its domain and style reflect the source, and the simplifications were written by English annotators. Previously available on GitHub: https://github.com/olgakanishcheva/Ukrainian-Text-Simplification/tree/main/ASSETUKR Citation: Kanishcheva, O. (2023). ASSETUKR: a Dataset for Ukrainian Text Simplification. LTC 2023.
